utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thank you, Oren. There are a few things around the house that need a careful hand, and I’d appreciate it if you could take a look.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Of course — just point me to the first thing that needs fixing, and I’ll take a look.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thank you. The first thing is the front door hinge—it’s been sticking a bit, so please take a careful look there first.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Mara. I’ll send over the short list so we can keep it simple and on schedule.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, Leo — a short list will help a lot. We’ll meet Sunday at the community center front entrance, and I’ll have a clear sign up for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great — I’ll keep it short and send the list over soon.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, I’m still sorting the last few repair items, but I’ll send the next match as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Bo — I appreciate it. Just send the next match when you’ve got it, and I’ll keep planning around the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — I’ll send the next match as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can swing by with a few tools and help sort out what’s still needed for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Gus — I’ll add tools to the list. If you can also keep an eye out for duct tape or extra work gloves, that’d help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: You got it — I’ll keep an eye out for duct tape and extra work gloves too.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Bo — send the next match when you’re ready, and I’ll check it against the repair drive details.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Of course, Eli — I’ll send the next match over as soon as I have it. And I’ll keep the repair drive details in mind while I do.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Mara. I’ll be ready to check it against the repair drive details when it comes in.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, it’s still happening — they’re expecting a few more volunteers this afternoon. I can swing by later and see if they still need anything.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Tess—please do, and let me know if they still need gloves or anything else. I’m waiting on the start time before I head over.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely—I’ll check back and let you know if they still need gloves or anything else. I’ll also ask about the start time and pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That’s great, Opal — thank you! I’ll keep spreading the word, and I’m glad you’re coming by.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Quinn — I’ve got the location now: the community center by the front entrance. I’ll look for the sign and be there.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect — that’s the one. I’ll see you at the front entrance, and if you think of anyone else who might help, please bring them along!

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh right — I still need to send those repair drive times over. Thanks for the reminder, Hana.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes—if you mean the repair drive at the community center, I’m checking the start time now and I’ll tell you right away.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — thanks, Hana. I’m waiting on the start time, then I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m glad to help with the repair drive. What still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m still good to help. What would you like me to tackle next?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Sam — could you start with whatever’s most urgent? I can take the next thing after that.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sure thing — I’ll keep spreading the word about the repair drive and remind folks what to bring.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Vik — that’d be great. If you can, let me know the start time too once you have it.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll keep spreading the word and let folks know the start time as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yes, it’s still happening — I’m just getting the word out and lining up a few volunteers for basic fixes. If you hear anything new, please let me know.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I can spread the word and ask around for a few handy volunteers. Tell me what kind of fixes you want covered, and I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That’d be great, Jules — mostly small home fixes like loose screws, leaky faucets, and other basic repairs. If you hear anything new, let me know and I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Mina — I’m still waiting on the start time too, so just let me know when Hana confirms. If it helps, Saturday morning sounds good on my end.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sounds good — I’m still waiting on Hana’s confirmation, but I’ll let you know as soon as I hear the exact time. Saturday morning works for me too.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Perfect, thanks — I’ll wait for your update and plan on Saturday morning for now.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’ve got the tools, screws, and spare wood ready, and I can help keep the list straight too. If anything else comes up before the drive, just send it my way.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, the repair drive is still on, right?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yes — it’s still on, and I’ve got the tools, screws, and spare wood ready. If anything changes, I’ll let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m happy to help with the repair drive — what still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Rey — I’m mostly worried about the logistics. We still need to confirm the supply list and who’s handling pickup and drop-off.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with that — I’ll check the supply list and see who can handle pickup and drop-off.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, I’m still good to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Sam — I’m still sorting the last few repair items, and I’ll send you the next match as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good, Bo — just send it over when you’re ready.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m still waiting on the start time too — Mina said Hana needs to confirm it first. I’ll let you know as soon as I hear anything.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Nell — I’ll keep the supply list open and wait for the start time update. If you hear back from Mina or Hana, just send it my way.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Will do — I’m keeping an eye out for Mina or Hana’s update and I’ll pass it along right away.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely—I'm still spreading the word about the repair drive, and you’re welcome to bring anyone who wants to help. If you want, I can also point folks toward the handrail, gate, and porch step fixes.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, good — I can probably help with one of those. Just point me to the first fix when we get there.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great — let’s start with the loose handrail when we get there, and I’ll point you to the others after that.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m heading to the community center front entrance and will look for your sign. If you still need anything, I can bring extra duct tape or work gloves.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Opal — that would be helpful. I’ll keep an eye out for you at the front entrance.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, I’ll see you at the front entrance soon.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, I’m a bit late, but I can still help with the repair drive. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sure thing—I’ll send the repair drive times over soon. Thanks for working around them.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good—send me the times when you can, and I’ll work around them.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thank you, Vik. I’ll show you the first thing when you’re ready.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word about the repair drive and make sure folks know what to bring. Go ahead and show me the first thing when you’re ready.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thank you, Vik. Let’s start with the front door hinge—it’s been giving me trouble.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can bring a few tools by and help sort out what’s still needed for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Gus — that’d be a big help. I’m still checking the exact setup, but we’re meeting at the community center by the front entrance.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great — I’ll meet you by the front entrance and bring the tools I’ve got. Just let me know what’s still needed once you’ve got the setup sorted.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good, Mara—just tell me what’s left when you get here.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Will do, Leo — I’ll check what’s left when I get there and let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Mara — I’ll be ready when you arrive.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Tess. A short plan helps: the handrail, the gate, and that porch step are the ones we still need to fix.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Got it — I’ll keep an eye on those three and bring the toolbox by this afternoon to help load everything up.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Tess. That afternoon plan sounds good, and I’ll keep my list ready.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes, it’s still happening on Sunday at the community center front entrance. I’ll have a clear sign up so you can find us.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, thanks. What time should I come on Sunday?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Please come by 10 AM on Sunday, and I’ll be there at the front entrance to greet you.
